title: Design tokens and layouts
brief: Tailwind theme from the design tokens, Inter + Source Serif 4, CSS variables, admin and public base layouts.

title: Shared UI components
brief: Blade/Flux components: button, input, status badge (icon + text), table, pagination, empty/loading/error state, confirm dialog, toast.

title: Auth screens
brief: Login, register, forgot email, forgot password in the dark split layout (Leonardo style).

title: OTP and reset screens
brief: OTP verification, reset password with live rules checklist, notices, throttle and error states.

title: Admin shell
brief: Sidebar and mobile nav from MenuRegistry filtered by permission, breadcrumbs, profile page.

title: Error pages
brief: Forbidden, unauthorized, not-found, server-error pages and Livewire error states.

title: Users and roles UI
brief: Users table with filters and status, roles with permission toggles (Teachable style), role request approvals.

title: Articles UI
brief: Article list with status tabs and bulk bar, editor with details panel, workflow actions.

title: Public layout and Home
brief: Public layout, footer, Home with CMS-driven sections.

title: Public articles
brief: Articles list and detail with sanitized Markdown and nested comments.

title: Public products
brief: Products list and book detail (Fable style).

title: About and Contact
brief: About (Zendesk style), contact form with success state, SEO title and meta.

title: Dashboard
brief: Role-adaptive dashboard widgets (pending approvals and similar).

title: Analytics UI
brief: Analytics page with date presets and line charts (Fingerprint style).

title: Logs and settings UI
brief: Audit log table (Cake style), error monitor, system information, settings with menu names.
